name: @dynamicagency/throughline-omp
description: Continuous, state-aware session memory for OMP (Oh My Pi). Captures what you did and what is (commands, file changes, decisions, and live git/PR state), then hands it off with judgment at session wrap-up. Readable, local-first artifacts (commit them if you choose).
